lines.en: Let's plan a trip for this summer.
Yes! Where do you want to go, Grandma?
I want to visit a foreign country.
Wow. Which country?
A country with a beautiful sea. What do you think?
lines.ko: 아름다운 바다가 있는 나라요. 어떻게 생각해요?

lines.en: Great idea. We will take many photos there.
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 거기서 사진을 많이 찍을 거예요.

lines.en: Two years ago, I traveled only in Korea.
This journey will be a new experience.
lines.ko: 이번 긴 여행은 새로운 경험이 될 거예요.

lines.en: Yes. Let's choose the destination together tonight.
lines.ko: 네. 오늘 밤에 목적지를 같이 정해요.

lines.en: Okay. I will bring the travel book.
Hi! How was your trip last week?
It was great. I traveled for ten days.
Wow. What was your best destination?
A village by the sea. We took a tour then.
lines.ko: 바다 옆 마을이요. 그때 우리는 관광을 했어요.

lines.en: Did you take many photos?
Yes! Look at this photo. It's the sea.
So beautiful. Was the foreign food good?
Yes, but I missed Korean food after three days.
lines.ko: 네, 하지만 사흘 후에는 한국 음식이 그리웠어요.

lines.en: I understand. I will travel there next year.
lines.ko: 이해해요. 내년에 저도 거기 여행 갈 거예요.

lines.en: Good. The journey is long, but the experience is great.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 긴 여행이지만 경험은 정말 좋아요.
